title: Terminal
description: Falling A–Y glyphs with 50 Hz movement and fading green trails.
notes: Original GPU reconstruction: 50 Hz glyph changes, one column per font-size unit, and 0.85-per-tick fading over 64 historical ticks. Hand-drawn 5×7 letters replace the browser font; deterministic bounded walks replace independent random motion. Color changes recolor the reconstructed trails; size changes rebuild them immediately. No keyboard input, font asset or proprietary effect code is included.
